name: What are common signs that my roof needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my roof needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs indicating roof repair is needed include missing, cracked, or curled shingles, especially after a storm. Look for granules in gutters, which signal shingle wear. Water stains on ceilings or walls, a sagging roof deck, or daylight visible through the attic roof can also point to leaks or structural issues. Regular inspections, particularly after strong winds or heavy rain, can help identify problems early and prevent more extensive damage to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for missing or damaged shingles, granules in gutters, or water stains indoors. A sagging roof or visible daylight from the attic also indicate potential issues.
